newsitem.title: LEBANON: Lebanon MEA ground crew, pilots on 24-hour strike.
newsitem.headline: Lebanon MEA ground crew, pilots on 24-hour strike.

text.p: Employees of Lebanon's national carrier Middle East Airlines went on strike on Tuesday to protest against the company's refusal to meet their pay demands.
Beirut airport sources said MEA's 200 pilots and 3,500 ground crew went on strike from midnight. The stoppage led to the cancellation of two scheduled early morning flights to Paris and London.

Eight other outgoing MEA flights and five incoming flights for Tuesday have been called off. Five other incoming flights for Arab and international airlines have also been cancelled as they offer airport services through MEA ground crew.
MEA staff are demanding an additional month's pay every year, but the airline says it is still in debt and cannot afford such payments.
